title: Asymptotic error distribution of Mittag--Leffler Euler method for a fractional stochastic differential equation
summary: In this paper, we investigate the asymptotic distribution of the normalized error for the Mittag--Leffler Euler (MLE) method applied to a class of multidimensional fractional stochastic differential equations. These equations are reformulated as stochastic Volterra equations (SVEs) featuring a non-diagonal, matrix-valued kernel $K(u)=u^{α-1}E_{α,α}(Au^α)$ with singular exponent $α\in (\frac{1}{2}, 1)$.
